arrive.text: Driving through the country. There's a storm coming.

flat.text: And a flat tyre. Right beside a barn.

tyre.text: Flat as a pancake. You'll be here a while.

barn.text: A barn. Red, with white trim. You can see it as plainly as anything.

same.text: And it looks exactly the same as every other barn along this road.

dry.text: Inside, it's dry. It really is a barn.

facades.text: But every other barn along this road is a front, propped up on sticks. From the road, you couldn't have told them apart. You just happened to run into the only real one.

end.text: You believed it was a barn. It was. You had good reason, and it kept you dry. Did you know?
